usage: sot-validator history-migrate [-h] --db-path DB_PATH [--apply]

Report the schema version of an existing SQLite HistoryStore database and the migrations this code
would apply. The default is a dry run that opens the database read-only and writes nothing; only
--apply runs the pending migrations, and they cannot be undone. JSON history files are not
supported, and a missing database is never created.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --db-path DB_PATH  Path to an existing SQLite HistoryStore database. JSON history files are not
                     supported.
  --apply            Run the pending migrations (cannot be undone). Without it the command is a
                     dry run that writes nothing.
